title: action.get
description: Retrieve actions according to the given parameters.

actionids.description: Return only actions with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only actions that use the given host groups in action conditions.

hostids.description: Return only actions that use the given hosts in action conditions.

triggerids.description: Return only actions that use the given triggers in action conditions.

mediatypeids.description: Return only actions that use the given media types to send messages.

usrgrpids.description: Return only actions that are configured to send messages to the given user groups.

userids.description: Return only actions that are configured to send messages to the given users.

scriptids.description: Return only actions that are configured to run the given scripts.

selectFilter.description: Return a filter property with the action condition filter.

selectOperations.description: Return an operations property with action operations.

selectRecoveryOperations.description: Return a recovery_operations property with action recovery operations.

selectUpdateOperations.description: Return an update_operations property with action update operations.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: actionid, name, status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
